title: No subprocess-based CLI test asserting stdout content
summary: tests/test_crc16_modbus_pure.py::TestCliImports exercises cli.py as in-process function calls only. A regression that broke argparse handling (e.g. accidental --data rename) or [project.scripts] mapping in pyproject.toml would not be caught. Card-03 fuzzers did not trigger (no crash/hang/oracle observed on cli_data or cli_self_test).

title: No >=1 MB stress test asserting bounded compute time
summary: Longest input currently tested is 65536 bytes (TestRegisterWidth.test_register_width_max). Card-03 fuzz/large_input ran 12 invocations at sizes [1, 1K, 100K, 1M] in 5.527s with zero OOM/hangs, empirically bounding CWE-400; no in-suite unit test asserts the bound.

title: No concurrent thread-safety test
summary: Implementation has no shared mutable state, but no test asserts thread-safety. Card-03 fuzz/cross_cycle ran 200000 single-process iters with zero mismatches (does not exercise true threads).

title: TestInitXoroutMatrix does not lock a specific CRC value against crcmod
summary: Existing 16-pair matrix asserts only isinstance(int) + 0 <= r <= 0xFFFF; a constant-return bug would pass. Card-03 fuzz/crc_oracle (100K iters) + fuzz/cross_cycle (200K iters) empirically locked the Modbus-default invariant — zero oracle mismatches — but the lock-in is not in tests/. Note: only the Modbus-default (init=0xFFFF, xorout=0x0000) pair can be byte-exact-locked against crcmod; non-default pairs differ by deliberate API convention.

title: python -m crc16_modbus_pure not exercised end-to-end via subprocess
summary: TestCliImports.test_main_module_wired only imports __main__ and verifies main_self_test is bound; does not actually invoke python -m. Card-03 fuzz/module_import (6 fresh subprocesses) + fuzz/cli_self_test (500 iters) empirically exercised the end-to-end path with zero anomalies, but no in-suite test asserts it.
